description: This file defines a React component for editing a defect in a defect tracking system. It manages state, handles API calls to fetch and update defect data, and provides a user interface for editing defect details including title, description, severity, status, root cause, and image upload.

methods.name: asId
methods.description: Converts a string or array of strings to a numeric ID.

methods.name: fileToBase64
methods.description: Reads a File object and converts it into a base64 encoded string.

methods.name: EditDefectPage
methods.description: Main React functional component for editing a defect, handling data fetching, form state, validation, and submission.
